title: HELLDIVERS 2

anticheat.note: nProtect GameGuard, a user-mode anti-cheat: CrossOver 26 users report it plays online through it, and it breaks with some game patches and comes back with the next. Not verified by Highball.

provenance: CrossOver 26 community reports (r/macgaming and r/Helldivers, 2026); on Highball one reporter hit the game's own 'Incompatible CPU detected' AVX check (highball#81, M5 Max, macOS 26.5.2, Highball 0.8.8, engine r0). Not verified by Highball.
notes: DirectX 12 only, so it needs Apple's D3DMetal (Play offers the licence) and the Wine 11 engine (CrossOver 26.3 tree), which is where CrossOver users play it. Its first check is the CPU: it requires AVX2 and refuses to start with 'Incompatible CPU detected' unless AVX is advertised through Rosetta, which the recipe does. GameGuard runs in user mode and CrossOver users play online through it; every game patch can break that until the next one. 135 GB on disk.

knownIssues.cause: the game requires AVX2 and Rosetta hides AVX unless asked
knownIssues.fix: the recipe sets ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX=1 (same as the Advertise AVX switch); Rosetta supports AVX2 on macOS 15 and later

knownIssues.symptom: No DirectX 12 device on the default engine
knownIssues.cause: the game is DirectX 12 only; DXMT and DXVK are DirectX 11 and 9
knownIssues.fix: D3DMetal on the Wine 11 engine, which Play offers

knownIssues.symptom: After the CPU check passes, the game warns that the GPU drivers are out of date (installed AMD 65535.65535.65535.65535), and after Continue it shows a black screen for a few seconds, closes, and opens the PlayStation crash reporter (reported on an M4 Pro with 24 GB, macOS 26.6.2, engine x64-crossover26.3-r7, D3DMetal, highball#81).
knownIssues.cause: a deadlock inside the game right after start, read from the reporter's full log on 2026-09-24: about a minute in, a game thread waits on one of the game's own critical sections (at 0x14190d008, inside its image) held by another thread that never releases it, RtlpWaitForCriticalSection times out at 60 s, and the process exits. What the holding thread is stuck on is not in the log. Three helper processes in the same session die of an NSException (-[NSViewBackingLayer setDisplaySyncEnabled:], sent by MoltenVK to a layer that is not a CAMetalLayer) right after creating a Vulkan instance, but those are not the game. CrossOver 26.2 lists a fix for Helldivers 2 not launching after a game update, and the only change naming the game in CrossOver 26.3's open Wine source (CW Hack 26536, set the app icon once) is already in Highball's Wine 11 engines, so that fix is not in the open code.
knownIssues.fix: none known yet. Not reproducible here, the game is not owned and is 135 GB.
